messages:
leo_sales: FYI Solaris team started a POC. During a 60-worker burst they see median first-byte ~1.6s but tails up to ~3.4s and occasional 429s. They also asked for a fixed POC rate and sent a security questionnaire. Can we swarm?

marie_se: Copy. Which deployment and sample request?

leo_sales: Hosted trial keys. Sample run: `time curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-TST" -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-3b","input":"Draft...","max_tokens":100}'` -> real 0m1.59s. Ramp spikes to 3s.

ash_ops: Two likely causes: routing batching favoring throughput under parallel load, and low KV/prefix cache hit-rate because their prompts vary.

nina_ml: Reproduced similar profile in staging when sequence-length variance is high. KV hit-rate dropped to ~14%, adding ~0.7-1.1s per request on cache-miss runs.

marie_se: Recommend offering short Dedicated eval (7-14 days) with a POC credit for predictable latency. Oliver, can finance pre-approve a small credit?

oliver_fin: We can propose a $X credit + reserved-slab pricing for the trial. Need estimate of GPU slab size; will draft numbers.

ash_ops: Immediate mitigations on Hosted (no infra change): set routing_policy: low_latency for their API key, lower max_batch_latency_ms to flush smaller batches, enable prefix prewarm for their session. Also advise client pacing (small connection pool + backoff on 429).

nina_ml: Config snippet I tested that improved TTFT: `routing_policy: low_latency, batching: {max_batch_size:6, max_batch_latency_ms:10}, cache: {prefix_prewarm:true}`. Also recommend moving static system prompt into cached prefix to improve KV hit-rate.

sec-bot: Security note: Provide SOC2 summary for Hosted. For customer-managed KMS/audit isolation recommend Redwood Private (VPC) POC — security can supply redacted docs.

leo_sales: Action items: (1) send client pacing sample to Solaris and ask for paced run logs, (2) offer Dedicated eval + pricing blurb, (3) forward SQ items to security. Ill post new logs here when they run. :thumbsup:
